title: feat: compare full weeks of revenue and signups
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows the full previous Monday–Sunday alongside the current week through today, below the main KPI table.
- Adds daily signups on a count axis beside revenue on a dollar axis; colors identify metrics and dashed lines identify last week.
- Extends the existing registrations pipe with daily grouping and a snapshot timestamp; future and unavailable values stay blank.
- Validated with 31 dashboard tests, the production build, a browser preview, staging query execution, and read-only production SQL confirming daily signup totals match the existing weekly totals.

Rollout: the Tinybird query must be promoted in staging and deployed/promoted in production before the daily signup endpoint is available. Existing weekly registration consumers retain their default response.

gist.headline: The dashboard reads the week
gist.blurb: The KPI garden now puts this week beside the last complete Monday–Sunday bloom. Revenue and signup sprouts get their own axes, because forcing unlike numbers into one pot was always a little strange.
gist.summary: The internal KPI dashboard now compares the current week through today with the full previous Monday–Sunday week, charting daily revenue and daily signup counts with grouped registration data and a snapshot timestamp.
gist.impact: Operators can distinguish revenue from signup volume at a glance via separate dollar and count axes, while dashed prior-week lines and blank future or unavailable days keep the comparison honest.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy internal analytics garden: Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, compares two adjacent weekly flower beds—one complete Monday–Sunday bed and one growing current-week bed. A retro CRT shows a clear two-axis chart with solid and dashed lines; small code-plants and calendar tiles represent daily grouped revenue and registrations.
